messages.subject: Project Quartz - completion checklist & arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
Eleanor,

Completion checklist attached for Friday. We'll do a virtual completion: documents in escrow held to order, signatures by counterpart, release on the call once funds are confirmed. Please ensure on your side: executed stock transfer forms, share certificates, board minutes, director resignations, statutory registers and the Pennine furnace-lease release.

We'll bring the W&I policy, the buyer board minutes and the funds.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
